pages.text: The World Shard Miner requires a complete same-block beacon base: Diamond Blocks for Overworld, Ancient Debris for Nether, and Purpur Blocks for End. Levels one through four determine speed and work in any dimension.

By default it weights the live world's ore-generation rules; packs may override with fixed tables. Realm output enters personal storage, while other dimensions use one barrel of internal cache and stop when full.
The Treasure Basin only observes the active miner directly below to choose a loot mode; the blocks never communicate. The basin owns a separate cache and blocks the beacon beam.
